# What CI runs. scripts/ci-plan.sh turns this into the tests workflow's
# matrices; scripts/matrix.sh and the documentation tests read it too.
#
# One entry per line: a kind, then a value. Releases run oldest first.
#
#   supported    a released tmux in the support table. A push or pull request
#                runs the first and the last.
#   refused      a release below the floor, started to prove it is refused
#   development  unreleased tmux. It runs with the whole table and may fail.
#   control      the first release with the control client the older-daemon
#                tests start
#   go           a Go toolchain the module jobs run

supported 3.3a
supported 3.4
supported 3.5
supported 3.6
supported 3.7
supported 3.7a
supported 3.7b
supported 3.7c
supported 3.8

refused 3.0a
refused 3.1c
refused 3.2a
refused 3.3

development master

control 3.7

go 1.26
